mechanism_claims.claim_text: RP557 shows rapid, concentration-dependent killing of Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus in bioluminescent time-kill assays; the paper interprets this as membrane-directed bactericidal activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local source supports rapid killing and author-stated membrane-disruption interpretation, but does not provide a direct membrane-permeabilization measurement in the extracted text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RP557 disrupts established bacterial biofilms, with source-reported EC90/EC50 values for MRSA, Pseudomonas aeruginosa PA14, and MDR Staphylococcus epidermidis biofilms.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm disruption is source-supported as a functional phenotype; molecular target details are not overclaimed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Serial-passage experiments did not select strong RP557 resistance under the tested conditions, while gentamicin and clindamycin resistance emerged in comparator arms.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RP557 against P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 and S. aureus ATCC 29213
